extra_quotes: To accelerate energetic evaluation and the repeated geometry optimizations required during the search, we employ SevenNet-Omni [23, 24], a universal machine-learning interatomic potential (MLIP), in place of computationally demanding DFT calculations [25, 26, 27, 16].

The current framework searches ordered structural models in which each Wyckoff site is fully occupied by a single element and therefore does not explicitly represent partial occupancies or substitutional disorder.
The PDF entries considered here provide peak positions and relative intensities but lack the full diffraction profiles required for Rietveld refinement [49].
